title: 7 Things to Know Before NMN + TMG
meta_description: A plain English guide to why NMN is often paired with TMG, what separate human studies measured, and what the research has not tested as a combination.

hero.title: to Know Before NMN + TMG
hero.summary_html: Summary: NMN and TMG have separate human evidence. Here is what each study measured, what it did not test, and why the pairing is still an evidence gap.

items.title: NMN changes a blood marker
items.body:
NMN is a precursor your body can use in NAD+ biosynthesis. Human trials have measured whether supplementation changes blood NAD-related markers.

That is a biochemical outcome, not a promise of more energy, better mood, or longer life.
items.alt: Abstract unmarked circles on cream paper beside water and travertine, illustrating a cellular pathway
items.evidence_label: Human RCT · Huang et al., Front Aging 2022

items.title: Results depend on the outcome
items.body:
In a 60-day trial of 66 adults aged 40 to 65, the NMN group’s blood NAD+/NADH rose 38% from baseline.

Placebo rose 14.3%. The study measured blood markers and selected health measures, not a universal feeling of vitality.
items.alt: Unmarked ceramic bowl, clear water glass and smooth stones on linen, illustrating a controlled daily protocol

chart.title: Blood NAD+/NADH change
chart.source: Huang et al., Front Aging 2022. 66 adults, 60 days, NMN vs placebo.

items.evidence_label: Human RCT · Huang et al., Front Aging 2022

items.title: TMG has a different research role
items.body:
TMG is another name for betaine. Its human research includes testing homocysteine, a marker related to methylation, rather than testing NAD+ levels.

That distinction matters: a finding about betaine alone cannot establish that adding it improves the response to NMN.
items.alt: Fresh beetroot halves and spinach leaves on a travertine board, illustrating food sources related to betaine research
items.evidence_label: Human RCT, TMG only · Olthof et al., J Nutr 2003

items.title: TMG evidence is separate
items.body:
TMG, also called betaine, has been studied on its own in healthy adults. One trial tested daily betaine against placebo for six weeks.

That study reported lower fasting homocysteine. It did not test NMN, NAD+, or this two-ingredient formula.
items.alt: Beetroot slices and clear water on travertine, illustrating a separate betaine study

chart.title: What the betaine trial tested
chart.source: Olthof et al., J Nutr 2003. Healthy adults, six weeks, betaine vs placebo.

items.evidence_label: Human RCT, TMG only · Olthof et al., J Nutr 2003

items.title: A rationale is not proof
items.body:
NMN and TMG are often discussed together because NMN research examines NAD-related metabolism while betaine research examines methylation-related markers.

Separate mechanisms can explain a pairing. They cannot establish that the combination improves a result.
items.evidence: Interpretation based on the separate NMN and betaine trials cited
items.alt: Unmarked smooth stones arranged in a chain on travertine, illustrating a proposed pathway without labels

items.title: No combined trial was found
items.body:
The human studies cited here tested NMN alone or betaine alone. A targeted Europe PMC search found no human trial testing NMN and TMG together.

That is an evidence gap, not evidence that the ingredients cannot be combined or that the formula works.
items.evidence: Evidence gap, targeted Europe PMC search
items.alt: Two empty open trays separated by a clear gap on linen, illustrating an untested combination
items.evidence_label: Literature check · no combined human trial found

items.title: The studies used daily routines
items.body:
The cited interventions followed daily routines over weeks, rather than occasional use. That design tells us what researchers actually tested.

For any supplement routine, the practical format is the one a person can follow consistently.
items.evidence: Study-design pattern across the cited human trials
items.alt: Clear water beside an unmarked weekly organizer on linen, illustrating a simple daily routine

bridge.title: Convenience is part of consistency
bridge.body:
The research tested repeatable routines, not occasional use. The useful question is which format you can follow without adding friction.

AgeAura Pure NMN + TMG NAD+ Complex is one option that puts both ingredients on one label, with the product details available for inspection.

Taking medication or managing a health condition? Ask your doctor before starting a supplement.
